title: Encoded length and padding word
statement: For natural numbers $C_w,c_w$ and a Boolean word $z$, let $v_j(z)$ and $v_p(z)$ be the natural numbers used by the given encoding. Define $b(z)$ to be the binary expansion of $v_j(z)$, followed by a word of $v_p(z)$ zeros.
caveat: The statement uses $v_j$ and $v_p$, but their definitions are not included in the supplied definitions or formal snippet; the resulting word does not depend on $C_w$ or $c_w$.
